senses.gloss: f. (גמל), ג׳ חֲסָדִים (also גְּמִילַת, v. גְּמִילָה) deeds of love, charity (abbr. ג״ח).
units: <cite ref="Sotah 14a:6">Sot. 14ᵃ</cite> the Torah <he>תחילתה ג״ח וכ׳</he> begins with charity (clothing the naked, <cite ref="Genesis 3:21">Gen. III, 21</cite>) and ends with charity (burying the dead, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 34:6">Deut. XXXIV, 6</cite>); a. v. fr.—[<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 1">Deut. R. s. 1</cite>, v. <cite ref="C01008"><he>גְּמוּל</he></cite>.]
